newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Communications lost subscribers in Q2-report.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Communications lost subscribers in Q2-report.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc suffered declines in basic cable and pay service subscribers in the second quarter, Broadcasting & Cable magazine reported in its June 30 issue.

Quoting analysts and industry executives familiar with TCI operations, the magazine reported that TCI was believed to have lost as many as 80,000-100,000 basic customers during the quarter, ended Monday. Pay units fell 500,000-700,000.
TCI has about 14 million subscribers in the U.S., making it the largest cable operator.
The magazine reported that cost cutting continued to boost profits, with analysts estimating $675-$725 million in cash flow for the quarter.
TCI officials had no immediate comment.
